# Agentum — Global Corporate Entity, VAT & Sanctions Resolver for AI Agents

> Deterministic global company registration resolution across national registries (UK Companies House, Swiss ZEFIX, Australian ABR, Singapore ACRA, US SEC EDGAR, European Registries, and Worldwide GLEIF LEI), live EU Commission VIES VAT validation, corporate bank payee verification, and OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening.

## Access & Pricing
- **Free Tier:** 5 free calls/day per agent (`X-Agent-Id` or IP) — zero signup or API keys required.
- **Inline HTTP 402 Micropayments:**
  1. **x402 v2 (`PAYMENT-REQUIRED` / `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`):** Settles USDC on Base (`eip155:8453` / testnet `eip155:84532`) to `0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD`.
  2. **Stripe + Tempo MPP (`WWW-Authenticate: Payment` / `Authorization: Payment`):** Settles Tempo stablecoins and Stripe PaymentIntents / Shared Payment Tokens.

## Available Tools
- `POST /v1/entity/resolve` (MCP: `resolve_entity`, $0.005/call): Deterministic Global Corporate Entity & Registry Resolver — Deterministic Global Corporate Entity & Registry Resolver. Resolves official national corporate registry records, company status, and business identifiers worldwide across primary commercial jurisdictions (including US, UK, EU-27, Switzerland, Australia, Singapore, and global LEI). Accepts company names, domains, or national registration numbers with optional ISO country code.
- `POST /v1/entity/vat-verify` (MCP: `verify_eu_vat`, $0.005/call): Verify EU VAT registration status via VIES — Validates European Union VAT identification numbers against the live official EU VIES system, linking against known company profiles.
- `POST /v1/entity/sanctions-screen` (MCP: `screen_sanctions`, $0.005/call): Screen entity or individual against global sanctions lists — Performs fuzzy and exact sanctions screening against OFAC SDN and EU Financial Sanctions with configurable similarity thresholds.
- `POST /v1/compliance/check-vendor` (MCP: `check_vendor`, $0.010/call): All-in-one 1-shot vendor KYB due diligence & compliance verdict — Composite autonomous KYB vendor due diligence tool. Concurrently resolves corporate identity across global registers, validates European Commission VIES VAT numbers, and screens global sanctions (OFAC/EU/UN). Returns a definitive compliance verdict (APPROVED, FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW, or REJECTED) with a full audit trail in a single round trip.
- `POST /v1/compliance/verify-bank-payee` (MCP: `verify_bank_payee`, $0.003/call): Verify SEPA / international IBAN format, checksum, and country alignment — Validates International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) using ISO 13616 specifications and MOD-97 checksum validation. Verifies whether the issuing country matches the expected corporate jurisdiction to prevent invoice fraud and redirection attacks.
- `POST /v1/entity/batch-resolve` (MCP: `batch_resolve`, $0.025/call): Batch resolve multiple corporate entities concurrently (up to 25) — Concurrently resolves multiple corporate entity names, registration numbers, or domains across national registries. Optimized for agent data pipelines, CSV processing, and batch supplier onboarding.
